def rotl8(x: uint8, k: int) -> uint8:
    """Rotate x left by k bits (k in 0..7); the high bits wrap around to the low end."""
    pre k >= 0 and k <= 7
    ex rotl8(0x81, 1) == 0x03
    ex rotl8(0x0F, 4) == 0xF0
    ex rotl8(0x55, 0) == 0x55
    v = int(x)
    r = ((v << k) | (v >> (8 - k))) & 0xFF
    return wrap_as[uint8](r)
